name: Tra Que Vegetable Village
kicker: Herb village north of the old town
summary: The herb beds about 2.5 kilometres north of the old town, or about 2 kilometres northeast on the national tourism page. Both distances stay. The greens go into cao lầu. A farmer hour, two shrines, and a stone well are on the heritage page. The fee, the hours, and the ride minutes are check on arrival.
timeNeeded: A morning. Exact minutes are check on arrival.
getThere: About 2.5 km north, or about 2 km northeast. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Herb beds and a path at Trà Quế

notice.title: It is a working village, not a ticketed museum
notice.body: No fee and no door hours are printed. The national intangible-heritage recognition, dated 4 April 2022, is for the growing. Ask what a farmer hour costs before you join one.

body: The heritage page of 3 January 2020 places Trà Quế about 2.5 kilometres north of the ancient-town centre, between the Đế Võng river and the Trà Quế lagoon, then in Cẩm Hà, which is now inside Hoi An Tây. The national tourism page says about 2 kilometres northeast and names more than 20 leaf and herb crops. Keep both distances. The cao lầu article names these greens on the bowl: húng lủi, young mustard, rau đắng, diếp cá.

The heritage page offers a farmer hour, the Ngũ Hành and Thổ Thần shrines, a stone well, and a basil-seed drink. The village festival Cầu Bông is the 7th of the first lunar month on the national tourism page. The trademark Rau Trà Quế Hội An dates from 2009, the traditional-craft recognition from 2016, and the national intangible heritage for the growing from 4 April 2022.

Go in the morning, on a bicycle or a short ride. The national page also names a boat. No clock time is printed for the ride, and no entry price is printed. Both are check on arrival. Do not treat the beds as a museum with a door.

gettingThere: Leave the old town to the north. The heritage page says about 2.5 kilometres. The national tourism page says about 2 kilometres northeast. The minutes are not printed. They are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the old town
legs.body: Bicycle or a short ride, about 2.5 kilometres north on the heritage page and about 2 kilometres northeast on the national tourism page. A boat is also named. The minutes are check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed.
admissionNote: No entry price is printed on the heritage page or the national tourism page. A farmer hour may cost extra. Ask before you join. Check on arrival.
